title_block.title: DC Electronic Load Rev E: block diagram
Front panel: OLED module, encoder, 3 buttons, 2 status LEDs
MCU: STM32G0B1RBT6 (LQFP64, the G0B1 JLC stocks), USB device, SPI to the isolated stage, I2C to the OLED
Board link: control board J10 to power board J11 over a 12-way IDC ribbon cable
Isolated interface: digital isolator, set-point DAC, readback ADC
Protection: over-temperature, dropout / KILL, NTC-open, over-voltage, hardware OFF
Set-point and hardware CV: V_SET divider, protective pull-downs, CV error amplifier
Sense: ISEN = mean of the four source nodes, VSEN = true 4-wire difference amplifier
Power path: DUT terminals, 58 V fuse, TVS, snubber, 4-wire sense
